notes.title: Devilishly Exciting Update from the You're Special Team! 😈✨
notes.content:
Hey there, Devil and Pitfall fans! 👋 We've got some hot news that'll make your hearts flutter faster than our charming devil's wings! 🔥💗

[h2]Native English Check: Partial Completion 🎉[/h2]

Remember when we mentioned we were working with a native English speaker? Well, guess what? They've been working their magic, and we're thrilled to announce that a portion of the English version has passed their expert scrutiny! 🌟🔍

[h2]What's New? 🆕[/h2]

We've polished up all the scenes leading right up to where things start getting... interesting with our devilishly handsome love interest. 😏 That's right, we're talking about everything from your first encounter to the moment just before your relationship with that charming devil takes an exciting turn!

[h2]The Spicy Stuff 🌶️[/h2]

Now, we know what you're all really waiting for - those tantalizing scenes that make Devil and Pitfall truly special. 😘 Rest assured, we're pouring our hearts (and a little bit of our souls) into making them absolutely perfect. They're still cooking, but trust us, they'll be worth the wait! 🔥⏳

[h2]Our Promise to You ❤️[/h2]

Here at You're Special, we're having an absolute blast bringing this game to life. Your enjoyment means everything to us, and we're committed to delivering the best devil dating experience out there! If any issues pop up along the way, we'll tackle them faster than you can say "sweet temptation"! ⚡️

We're beyond grateful for your patience and support. You truly are special to us, and that's why we'll keep working tirelessly to ensure Devil and Pitfall exceeds your every expectation.

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those pitchforks ready for more devilish fun! 😈🍴

With love and a touch of mischief,
The You're Special Team 💕👹

notes.title: Love Speaks All Languages: Major English Update for Devil and Pitfall! 💖🌍
notes.content:
Hey there, Devil and Pitfall fans! 👋😈

The You're Special team here with some devilishly good news! 🎉✨
We've been working our tails off to improve the English version of our charming devil dating sim, and we're excited to share that we've just released a major translation update! 🚀🔥

While we had a few hiccups with the initial release (oops, our bad! 😅), we've given the entire English translation a complete overhaul. It's now smoother than your devilish love interest's pick-up lines! 😎💬 We're pretty confident it's a massive improvement, but hey, nobody's perfect - there might still be a few quirks hiding in there. 🙈

But wait, there's more! 🥁 We're incredibly fortunate to be collaborating with a dedicated native English speaker who's generously lending their expertise to give the game an extra polish. 🌟 Their invaluable insights are helping us ensure our devilish dialogue truly shines. We can't wait to share this ultra-refined version with you, but we're keeping the release date under wraps for now. Good things come to those who wait, right? 🤫⏳

Rest assured, we're not stopping here. Our team is having a blast working on Devil and Pitfall, and we're committed to making it the best devil dating experience out there. 💯 If any issues pop up, we'll tackle them faster than you can say "sweet temptation"! ⚡️

We pour our hearts (and a little bit of our souls) into this game, and your enjoyment means the world to us. 💖 Thank you for your patience and support - you truly are special to us! 🙏
Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those pitchforks ready for more devilish fun! 😈🍴

Love,
The You're Special Team 💕👹
